AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: The sim has no add-to-room phase - creature creation *is* construction - so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (louse_progenitor.py:32-34). SHARED-FINDINGS section 2's shared verdict, copied: the game runs these from MonsterModel.AfterAddedToRoom via CombatManager.AfterCreatureAdded (CombatManager.cs:860-867) inside StartCombatInternal (CombatManager.cs:394-398), i.e. after every creature is on the board and before Hook.BeforeCombatStart (CombatManager.cs:403); the sim runs them at create_monsters (combat.py:134), before relics attach (combat.py:157-159), before belt potions register (combat.py:164-166), before the parity Niche HP roll (combat.py:152-153) and before hooks.on_combat_start (combat.py:208). Same observable today on all three of section 2's clauses (listener set / HP-roll inversion / roll ordering); executed for this unit by `py audit/tools/monster_probes_b05.py rocket-ctor`, which prints the listener set at monster-construction time for a two-monster hive encounter: ['CombatHistory','StrikeCard','DefendCard', the previously-created monster's own powers] - no relic, no potion. GenerateMoveStateMachine.rationale: Three-node fixed cycle, no branch state. C# (LouseProgenitor.cs:73-85): WEB_CANNON -> CURL_AND_GROW -> POUNCE -> WEB_CANNON, registered [CURL, WEB, POUNCE], initialState = WEB_CANNON. The sim wires the same ring, the same registration order (louse_progenitor.py:51 passes [curl, web, pounce]) and the same initial state. WEB carries SingleAttackIntent + DebuffIntent -> also=(DEBUFF,), CURL carries DefendIntent + BuffIntent -> Intent(DEFEND, also=(BUFF,)).

guards.what: the Curled flag and the uncurl step at the head of WEB and POUNCE

Executed by reading every reader of Curled: the only ones are those two anim blocks and the animator's curled_loop / die_curled states (:129-142). The flag gates no damage, block, power or transition, so the sim's omission loses nothing mechanical.
